title: Promo spend while single-lane stores recover

messages.text: The app coupon push is driving Double Stack orders into single-lane stores that cannot stage it. Pausing the Southeast radio flight until window times come back.
Good call. Dual-lane stores are coping, so if you keep spending, point it at markets with dual-lane kitchens.
Shifting the app coupon to dual-lane markets in the West for two weeks. Will revisit once pre-staging is in place everywhere.
